package jslogproto

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestReviewRejectedRetryAfterClientRestart(t *testing.T) {
	e := newEnv(t, 1)
	coord := e.coordinator("review", func(o *CoordinatorOptions) {
		o.Admission = &AdmissionOptions{HighSagas: 10, LowSagas: 2, StaleAfter: time.Minute}
	})
	e.takeAll(coord, false)
	coord.adm.set("part.review", PartLoad{Records: 100, At: time.Now().UnixMilli()})
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	ch, err := e.client.StartIntent(ctx, "same", e.transfer(0, false))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	select {
	case <-ch:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
	if e.client.Latest()["same"].Status != StatusRejected {
		t.Fatal("not rejected")
	}
	newer, err := NewClient(ctx, e.js, e.l)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer newer.Close()
	waitUntil(t, time.Second, "replayed rejection", func() bool { return newer.Latest()["same"] != nil })
	stream, err := e.js.Stream(ctx, e.l.StreamOf(0))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	before, err := stream.GetLastMsgForSubject(ctx, e.l.StartSubject(0))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	coord.adm.set("part.review", PartLoad{Records: 0, At: time.Now().UnixMilli()})
	_, err = newer.StartIntent(ctx, "same", e.transfer(0, false))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	after, err := stream.GetLastMsgForSubject(ctx, e.l.StartSubject(0))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if after.Sequence == before.Sequence {
		t.Fatalf("retry acknowledged but not appended: start seq remains %d; restarted client reused MsgID", after.Sequence)
	}
}
func TestReviewConcurrentRetryNotifiesAllWaiters(t *testing.T) {
	e := newEnv(t, 1)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	first, err := e.client.StartIntent(ctx, "same", e.transfer(0, false))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	second, err := e.client.StartIntent(ctx, "same", e.transfer(0, false))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(Event{V: WireVersion, Saga: &Saga{ID: "same", Version: 1, Status: StatusCompleted}})
	if _, err = e.js.Publish(ctx, e.l.EvSubject(0, "done"), raw); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	select {
	case <-second:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
	select {
	case <-first:
	case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
		t.Fatal("first caller stranded after second StartIntent overwrote its waiter")
	}
}
func TestReviewAdmissionMustWaitForInitialSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	a := newAdmission(AdmissionOptions{HighSagas: 10}, func() int64 { return 1000 })
	if a.ready {
		t.Fatal("unexpected initial ready")
	}
	if open, _, _ := a.evaluate(); open {
		t.Fatal("admission opens before initial KV load snapshot is read")
	}
}
